assertions.text: Report confirms Phase 1 (LRU cache) is correctly implemented
Report confirms Phase 2 cache integration works for get_user, update_user, and delete_user
Report identifies that get_user_count reads from cache instead of the store
Report explains that get_user_count will return wrong results after cache invalidation or for users not yet cached
Report identifies this as a regression introduced by the caching integration
Report notes the test suite does not cover the get_user_count regression scenario
